title: Spectra — Fourier Lab
description: A twelve-mode interactive Fourier & DSP lab on a from-scratch FFT. Draw shapes redrawn by rotating vectors, build and HEAR spectra, filter noise in the frequency domain, read spectrograms, and SHARPEN them: time-frequency REASSIGNMENT and SYNCHROSQUEEZING collapse a fuzzy chirp band to a razor line tracing its instantaneous frequency, with a Rényi-entropy readout of the gain. Analyse LIVE MICROPHONE audio in real time (scrolling spectrogram + a pitch tuner that names the note). DESIGN digital filters on an interactive z-plane — drag poles and zeros by hand and watch magnitude, phase, group delay, impulse response and sound recompute live from a from-scratch bilinear transform (Butterworth, Chebyshev, FIR, biquad), including the OPTIMAL families: elliptic (Cauer) filters from scratch-built Jacobi elliptic functions, Parks–McClellan equiripple FIR via the Remez exchange, and a design-to-spec panel that picks the minimum order for every family. Plus a Morlet wavelet vs STFT, a real 2-D image FFT, a phase-vocoder time-stretch/pitch-shift, a JPEG-lite DCT codec, and cepstral pitch detection. Deep-linkable; no math libraries.
